title: satureja kuegleri
intro: Satureja kuegleri, commonly known as Balkan savory, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as preventing the growth of certain pathogens. The therapeutic actions of Satureja kuegleri include its ability to act as an antioxidant, reducing oxidative stress, and its potential in treating gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Satureja kuegleri include carvacrol, borneol, and thymol, among others, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
